## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** LayeredFS is read at boot (switch-mods.md; donor_swap.py). In-session swap = apply_live / sessions/{sid}/swap -> restart_title (round lost; proven on RE5 Eden). switch_mods op=hotswap (same length, round boundary) proven on RE6/Yuzu only, untested on RE4/Citron.

**Pick whip: none.** pick_identify has no RE4/Switch backend (pick_tool LIVE_PLATFORMS has no switch; the picker falls back to a colour region). Ingredients exist: unit pos +0xA4, camera block pG+0xA8 (ProjMat +0x10C), the laser's m_SightEm, tactical-map clicks on Ganados.

**Live controls:** merc_live_controls MODS['re4']: Unlimited life, One-hit kills, Enemy health x, Time per kill, Weapon power x, Max level, RAM aim lock, Fire rate x, Infinite ammo, Random weapon; model_swap op (donor_swap: RE4 slot goes native next boundary, new build = restart); decrypt-lab RAM hex scanner

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- No RAM link from a unit to its drawn pack, BIN or texture, and no hook into the loader that streams em/pl packs: a mesh cannot change mid-round.
- NCE rule: Citron runs RE4 natively (NCE) and the Spark's cores have no I-cache coherency (CTR_EL0 DIC=0), so gBox must not rewrite executed guest code (LOADOUT_CODE_PATCH=False after every stage load hung).
- Allowed code routes under NCE: data writes, boot-time ExeFS overlays, or code in never-run zero padding via the code segment's backing file reached by data (RE5/RE6 controllers). RE4 has no such native call harness yet.
- No-reboot file swap untested on RE4: switch_mods op=hotswap (same length, round boundary) is proven on RE6/Yuzu (i9) only; whether RE4 re-reads em/pl udas at each stage load on Citron is unknown.
- Character -> pack table in main not read: Ada (pl0b vs pl0c/pl16), HUNK/Krauser/Wesker are art-inferred; only pl08 = Leon was shown live.
- ESL type byte -> Ganado body slot is inferred; no frame shows four different Village donors at once.
- Pickwhip: no RE4 Switch entity backend; the camera's in-round projection against unit positions is not verified.
- No registered switch_mods character writer for 010099A00BC1E000: characters op=use does not route; builds come from the re4_switch_models / re4_switch_enemies CLIs + switch_mods op=write.
- Donor materials are plain: cut-outs need an opacity-map material (byte 14, GX I4) the writer does not write; a material colour tint stops the stage load.
- Fitted-cast acceptance (fit v4) is in session notes, not a repo receipt; the four Leon probe overlays never reached an in-round frame.
- Ops: Mercenaries needs a save past the Village (auto-loaded at boot); one Switch emulator per PC; Citron only; builds must sit under 270a15eb98dab4d7.
- RAM map file is stale: 010099A00BC1E000-ram.json says Eden-only, units_per_m 100 and mercs.ready false, while the driver measures mm on Citron.
